bathymetry.method: Six point nearshore transect plus 6 km forecast-anchor check; model elevations in source datum, not tide heights or a refraction model

tide_resolution.method: Read-only invocation of production CO-OPS fallback resolver on final names/coordinates. Cached tide refresh independently chooses the nearest NOAA prediction station within 120 km.
tide_resolution.reference_role: Editorial station reference is not a runtime override or datum-specific spot calibration.
